_comment: Instruction-selection contract for the gfx942 (CDNA3) code objects, asserted by asm_audit.py
against the disassembly. The gfx950 twin is scripts/asm_expect_gfx950.json and this file is
NOT a copy of it with a different name -- the two contracts are INVERSES on both matrix axes:
gfx950 (CDNA4)                 gfx942 (CDNA3)
bf16 MFMA    v_mfma_f32_32x32x16_bf16       v_mfma_f32_32x32x8_bf16   (half the K)
fp8  MFMA    v_mfma_f32_32x32x64_f8f6f4     v_mfma_f32_32x32x16_fp8_fp8
so the gfx950 file FORBIDS v_mfma_f32_32x32x16_fp8_fp8 -- correct there, where selecting it
means half rate -- while here it is the only fp8 matrix instruction the silicon has, and its
ABSENCE is the failure. One expectation file cannot state both, which is why running the
gfx950 contract over a gfx942 object asserted the exact opposite of the truth. asm_audit.py
reads each object's arch out of its own ELF header and refuses the pairing.
SPELLING: ROCm 7.2.4 / clang-23 prints the CDNA3 bf16 MFMA as v_mfma_f32_32x32x8_bf16; older
AMDGPU asm printers spelled the same instruction v_mfma_f32_32x32x8bf16_1k. require_min
matches on the common prefix so a toolchain bump does not read as an instruction-selection
regression, while the forbid entries stay exact -- they are the thing being asserted.
COVERAGE. These are the rows a `PLOW_ROWS_ONLY=interp_prefill bash scripts/build_gfx942.sh`
produces, i.e. what can be audited without a full 28-object build. The decode objects are not
here yet: gfx942 decode ships PLOW_OCC4=1, which is a different tile and a different register
budget, and an expectation written against a non-occ4 decode object would describe an object
nobody serves.
Keys are object-name substrings; the LONGEST match wins. Values are kernel-name substrings
-> checks. _arch is asserted against each object's ELF header before any rule runs.
_fp8_note: The fp8 prefill object legitimately holds BOTH matrix families: d_gemm_fp8_t and
d_gemm_glu_fp8 issue the fp8 MFMA, while the bf16 bodies (d_gemm_t, d_gemm_glu, the Gemma
grouped-MoE prefill pair) are inlined into the same plow_exec. Requiring both is what
distinguishes 'the fp8 arm is present' from 'the fp8 arm silently dequantized to bf16' --
the CDNA3 shape of the w4a16-wearing-an-A4W4-name failure the gfx950 file documents.
cbsz/blgp are deliberately NOT asserted here. They are f8f6f4 operand-format fields; the
CDNA3 fp8 MFMA has no such field, so every instruction reads as (0,0) and the check would
